ast.target: 打破平衡并启动故事的事件。

ast.target: 主角投身于旅程——第一幕结束。

ast.target: 主角正面迎击核心冲突。

ast.name: description

ast.name: description

ast.source: The hero receives a challenge or quest.

ast.name: description
ast.source: The hero gains guidance, training, or a gift.

ast.name: description
ast.source: The hero commits to the journey and enters the special world.
ast.target: 主角决心踏上旅程，进入特殊世界。

ast.name: description
ast.source: The hero encounters challenges, makes allies, and faces enemies.
ast.target: 主角遭遇挑战，结交盟友，面对敌人。

ast.name: description

ast.target: 主角为中央试炼做准备。

ast.name: description
ast.source: The hero faces a life-or-death crisis.

ast.name: description
ast.source: The hero claims the prize or knowledge gained.
ast.target: 主角取得所获的奖赏或知识。

ast.name: description
ast.source: The hero begins the journey home, but faces pursuit or complications.
ast.target: 主角踏上归途，但面临追击或波折。

ast.name: description
ast.source: The hero is tested once more — a final, purifying ordeal.
ast.target: 主角再次受到考验——最终的净化试炼。

ast.name: description
ast.source: The hero returns transformed, bearing gifts or wisdom for the world.
ast.target: 英雄蜕变归来，为世界带回礼物或智慧。

ast.name: description
ast.source: The starting state — opposite of the resolution. Draw the reader in.
ast.target: 起始状态——与结局相反。吸引读者进入。

ast.name: description
ast.source: The event that sets the story in motion and moves the character from reaction to action.
ast.target: 推动故事展开、使角色从被动反应转向主动行动的事件。

ast.name: description
ast.source: Apply pressure. Force the character to act — something goes wrong.
ast.target: 施加压力。迫使角色采取行动——某件事出了差错。

ast.name: description
ast.source: The character shifts from reaction to action. They commit to the goal.
ast.target: 角色从被动反应转向主动行动。他们下定决心追求目标。

ast.name: description
ast.source: More pressure. The situation seems hopeless — jaws of defeat.
ast.target: 更多压力。局势似乎毫无希望——败局已定。

ast.name: description
ast.source: The character obtains the final piece they need to succeed.
ast.target: 角色获得了成功所需的最后一块拼图。

ast.name: description
ast.source: The climax and resolution — the opposite of the Hook.
ast.target: 高潮与结局——与钩子相反。

ast.name: description
ast.source: Establish the character in their comfort zone.

ast.name: description
ast.source: The character wants or needs something.
ast.target: 角色想要或需要某样东西。

ast.name: description
ast.source: The character enters an unfamiliar situation.
ast.target: 角色进入一个陌生的情境。

ast.name: description
ast.source: The character adapts and searches for what they need.
ast.target: 角色适应环境，并寻找自己需要的东西。

ast.name: description
ast.source: The character finds what they wanted.
ast.target: 角色找到了自己想要的东西。

ast.name: description
ast.source: The character pays a heavy price for it.
ast.target: 角色为此付出了沉重的代价。

ast.name: description
ast.source: The character returns to their familiar situation.
ast.target: 角色回到他们熟悉的情境。

ast.name: description
ast.target: 角色发生了根本性的改变。

ast.name: description
ast.source: Show the protagonist in their everyday life and what holds them back from love. Hint at their external goal and internal need.
ast.target: 展现主角在日常生活中的样子，以及是什么阻碍了他们追求爱情。暗示他们的外在目标和内在需求。

ast.name: description
ast.source: Show the love interest in their everyday life and what holds them back from love. Hint at their external goal and internal need.
ast.target: 展现恋爱对象在日常生活中的样子，以及是什么阻碍了他们追求爱情。暗示他们的外在目标和内在需求。

ast.name: description
ast.source: The two heroes meet for the first time — memorable, sparky, and hinting at why they might be perfect for each other (and why now is not the time).
ast.target: 两位主角第一次相遇——令人难忘、火花四溅，并暗示为什么他们可能天生一对（以及为什么现在还不是时候）。

ast.name: description
ast.source: One hero denies (internally or externally) that they will ever fall in love, especially not with this person. Make the argument compelling.
ast.target: 一位主角（在内心或外表上）否认自己会坠入爱河，尤其是不会爱上这个人。让这个论点有说服力。

ast.name: description
ast.source: An event or situation forces the heroes to stay close and work together toward a shared goal. They cannot walk away from each other.
ast.target: 一个事件或情境迫使主角们保持亲近，并朝着共同目标携手合作。他们无法彼此抽身离开。

ast.name: description
ast.source: Despite being stuck together, the protagonist fights their feelings and restates the argument against love. External and internal goals clash.
ast.target: 尽管被迫在一起，主角仍抗拒自己的感情，并重申反对爱情的理由。外部目标与内部目标发生冲突。

ast.name: description
ast.source: The heroes start to realize they might fall in love — a glimpse of a different side of each other, or an inexplicably romantic moment.
ast.target: 英雄们开始意识到自己可能坠入爱河——瞥见彼此不同的一面，或一个莫名浪漫的瞬间。

ast.name: description
ast.source: No denying it anymore: the characters are falling for each other. They grow closer and show glimpses of who they really are.
ast.target: 再也无法否认：角色们正在彼此倾心。他们愈发亲近，并流露出真实的自我。

ast.name: description
ast.source: Both heroes begin to believe love could work. The "no way" argument is in doubt, but the growing relationship creates tension with external goals.
ast.target: 两位主角开始相信爱情可以成功。“绝无可能”的论点受到质疑，但日益发展的关系与外部目标产生了冲突。

ast.name: description
ast.source: The tension culminates in an expression of affection — usually a kiss (or more). A false high: it feels like everything will work out.
ast.target: 紧张感在爱意的表达中达到高潮——通常是一个吻（或更多）。虚假的高潮：感觉一切都会好起来。

ast.name: description
ast.source: After the high of the midpoint, uncertainty sets in. Old fears resurface and the heroes start to let their doubts get the better of them.
ast.target: 在中间点的高潮之后，不确定性开始出现。旧的恐惧重新浮现，英雄们开始让疑虑占据上风。

ast.name: description
ast.source: Insecurities run high. A misunderstanding or external pressure exploits the original "no way" reasons and drives the heroes apart.
ast.target: 不安全感高涨。一次误解或外部压力利用了最初的“绝无可能”理由，将英雄们推向分裂。

ast.name: description
ast.source: It’s all too much. To stay safe, the heroes retreat and misunderstand each other. Trust is broken; the pain of connection feels too great.
ast.target: 一切都太过沉重。为了安全，主角们退缩并互相误解。信任被打破；连接的痛苦显得过于巨大。

ast.name: description
ast.source: The worst has happened — the "no way" fear has come true. The protagonist reaffirms their commitment to hardening their heart and being alone.
ast.target: 最坏的情况发生了——"不可能"的恐惧成真了。主角重申决心，要 hardened 自己的心、独自一人。

ast.name: description
ast.source: It’s over. The relationship ends and the reader cannot tell if the heroes will find their way back. The protagonist chose not to be vulnerable.
ast.target: 结束了。关系终止，读者无法判断主角们是否会重新走到一起。主角选择不展现脆弱。

ast.name: description
ast.source: The protagonist wallows after the breakup. They should feel better, but feel worse. They relive happy memories and hint at a way back.
ast.target: 主角在分手后沉溺其中。他们本应感觉更好，却感觉更糟。他们重温美好回忆，并暗示了一条回归之路。

ast.name: description
ast.source: The protagonist chooses love over fear. They realize they have agency and decide to address their flaws and fight for the relationship.
ast.target: 主角选择爱而非恐惧。他们意识到自己拥有主动权，决定直面自身缺陷并为这段关系而战。

ast.name: description
ast.source: One character takes a big risk to show they have changed and their love can conquer all. The gesture must be big enough to make up for past errors.
ast.target: 一个角色冒着巨大风险来表明自己已经改变，他们的爱能战胜一切。这一举动必须足够大，以弥补过去的错误。

ast.name: description
ast.source: It worked. The heroes are together, have addressed the issues that kept them apart, and are ready for their happily ever after.
ast.target: 成功了。主角们走到了一起，解决了让他们分离的问题，并准备好迎接幸福结局。

ast.name: description
ast.source: A glimpse into the future: the heroes living their lives together, both changed for good. A moment of celebration and reader payoff.
ast.target: 对未来的惊鸿一瞥：英雄们共同生活，彼此都发生了永久的改变。一个庆祝与回馈读者的时刻。

ast.name: description

ast.name: description

ast.name: description

ast.name: description

ast.name: description
